summary: Faster canonical event hashing, single line parse and storage engine benchmark

delivery.outcome: canonical() hashes events about 17% faster with identical output and errors, line_to_request can reuse an already parsed line, the reference ES schema is checked on live PostgreSQL when DATA_PLANE_PG_DSN is set, and benchmarks/engines.py measures SQLite, SQLite with group commit, PostgreSQL and PGlite on the same workload.
nonGoals: Change hashes, canonical form, contracts, schemas or error codes
Make a live database or psycopg a requirement of the default test suite
Add the QA dependency, Makefile target or analysis report (separate integration ticket)

architecture.decision: Replace the recursive canonical() with an explicit-stack walk that keeps the same key order, number rules and errors; add an optional keyword-only parsed= argument to line_to_request so callers that already parsed the line skip a second parse. The live PostgreSQL test and the engine benchmark are additive and skip without a DSN or driver.
interfaceChanges: conformance.line.line_to_request gains optional keyword-only parsed= (backward compatible)
architecture.rollback: Close the PR; after publication revert the merge commit.
